title: Feature: Test and validation cost
hero: What our tests and checks cost, where they repeat, and what to cut
lede: Studied 11 October: the checks are good, but they run too often and for everything. Half of all CI time was agents’ branch runs, a luismc-artifacts change waits 17.5 min where 3.8 would prove the same, and the mutation pass and a duplicate renderer group are most of the rest. Eight fixes are ranked below; the owner chose all of them (D1 to D8), and they are To do.
